name: assert diff messages and custom messages
source: import * as assert from 'node:assert'; function t(n: string, f: () => void): void {   try { f(); console.log(n, 'no throw'); } catch (e: any) { console.log(n, e.code, e.operator, e.generatedMessage, JSON.stringify(e.message)); } } function main(): void {   t('ne', () => assert.notStrictEqual(1, 1, 'c'));     t('eq', () => assert.equal(1, 2, 'c'));   t('seobj', () => assert.strictEqual({ a: 1 }, { a: 1 }));   t('seobj2', () => assert.strictEqual([1, 2], [1, 3]));   t('sediff', () => assert.strictEqual('a', 'a '));   t('setype', () => assert.strictEqual(1, '1' as any));   t('semulti', () => assert.strictEqual('a\nb', 'a\nc'));   t('dse2', () => assert.deepStrictEqual([1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 4]));   t('dse3', () => assert.deepStrictEqual(1, 2));   t('dse4', () => assert.deepStrictEqual({ a: 1, b: { c: 2 } }, { a: 1, b: { c: 3 } }));   t('nds', () => assert.notDeepStrictEqual({ a: 1 }, { a: 1 }));   t('ne2', () => assert.notEqual(1, 1));   t('thr', () => assert.throws(() => {}, TypeError));   t('thr2', () => assert.throws(() => {}, TypeError, 'msg'));   t('thr3', () => assert.throws(() => { throw new Error('x'); }, TypeError));   t('fail', () => assert.fail('x'));   t('fail0', () => assert.fail());   t('dnt', () => assert.doesNotThrow(() => { throw new Error('a'); }, 'm')); }
